title: Egyptian Oat Tagine
description: A unique twist on traditional oatmeal, inspired by the flavors of Egypt. This hearty breakfast dish is perfect for a cold morning.

ingredients.name: tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: or a mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the velvety milk to a simmer.
Add the oats, tagine spice blend, and unique spice (if using) to the saucepan.
Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes or until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid.
Stir in the maple syrup and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon or a dollop of whipped cream (if desired).
Optional: top with sliced fresh fruit or a sprinkle of chopped nuts.
